definitions: A device for catching animals, typically one that snares or holds them.
A situation in which people are caught unawares, especially one that is designed to trick them.
A U-shaped pipe that prevents the passage of gas but allows the passage of liquid.
examples: The mouse was caught in the trap.
It was a trap to make him confess.
They rode in a horse-drawn trap.
The plumber fixed the trap under the sink.
